An FCA approved risk manager (SMF3 and SMF4) with over 20 years hands-on experience covering the first and second lines of defence at both buy and sell side firms. 

Extensive international experience leading projects in the US, France, Italy, Germany, Singapore, Japan, and a multi-jurisdictional placement (20+ legal entities for a tier 1 GSIB).

Career highlights include: -

•	Project lead on 9 section 166 skilled person reviews.

•	Design and implementation of the risk global target operating model for a UK GSIB. 

•	Led the risk transformation program at a GSIB including driving the remediation plan and working with the group and country risk teams to design, build and implement solutions which would address regulatory concerns and move the bank’s management of risk in-line with industry good practice.

•	Led the development and implementation of the Enterprise Risk management framework for the US arm of a European based GSIB in response to consent orders issues by the OCC and the FED. 

•	Led the identification of how to leverage existing risk frameworks and practices as an input into a new framework to remedy a section 166 at a global wealth manager. 

•	Led the risk workstream of a major transformational programme at a GSIB. This included ensuring the project adequately identified and understood the risks of undertaking the project, the development of the requirements and operating model of the risk function and the articulation of the independent risk review of the programme.

•	Led the review of risk identification, assessment and monitoring at a Middle Eastern IB.

•	Led multiple workstreams reviewing Risk Management Framework implementations across the first and second line, including responsibility for defining the target state, conducting a gap analysis and designing a roadmap to remediate identified deficiencies in a UK bank.

•	Led the governance workstream for a s166 review of multiple UK legal entities of a global asset manager. This included the review of current outsourcing, third party risk management and oversight arrangements.

•	Designed, built and implemented a risk framework from scratch at a fin-tech start-up.

•	Skilled framework remediation practitioner having worked with numerous regulatory bodies - FCA, PRA, ASIC, FED, FRB, BaFIN, CYSEC, FDIC, SEC, AMF, FINMA, DFSA, AFM and FSA (Japan).

person.headline: CEO/Founder | @Kybotech
person.about_me:
Initiating my business journey from a room above my parents' garage in 2000, I founded Kybotech with the straightforward aim to modernise my family's garden buildings manufacturing business. However, when that plan fell through with the sale of our family business, I pivoted. I built Kybotech's factory from the ground up, transforming it into a £28M+ company with a diverse product range, from garden buildings to online health solutions and more.

Today, Kybotech employs over 200 staff across facilities in Worksop and Hull. We're the force behind successful brands like Store More, TimberX, and BillyOh. While the company has grown, the core values of innovation, directness, and engagement have stayed constant.

But the journey doesn't stop here. My goal is to expand Kybotech into a £100M operation, and I'm actively seeking partnerships, acquisitions, and new markets to achieve that.

In addition to leading Kybotech, I invest in growth-focused companies and mentor tech startups. I'm always open to connecting with like-minded professionals. Feel free to reach out.

person.headline: Head of HR | @ALBERT BARTLETT
person.about_me:
‘What makes people tick?’ 

My enduring fascination with this question launched my HR career over 20 years ago. Understanding the business/people dynamic and finding that win-win balance remains my passion.

I have worn many hats during my career, including; recruiter, trainer, manager, confidante, disciplinarian, counsellor, coach, mentor and strategist. As a result, I am well positioned to help a business develop and deliver a compelling people strategy that drives business success.

What makes me tick?

-	A compelling vision.
-	Great leaders - I am in awe of them. I aspire to be one.
-	Recruiting people into roles which match their skills.
-	Identifying and developing talent. Everyone has talent.
-	Making a difference through using and developing my own strengths.
-	Sincere feedback. I want to grow.
-	Celebrating success - I don’t care who gets the credit. I just want us to win.

I love making new professional acquaintances. Reach out if you want to talk HR, business or rugby (my passion outside the office).

Specialties: Managing, coaching, seeing problems from all points of view, recruitment, employee relations, emotional intelligence, talent development, HR strategy, interpersonal savvy, mediation, training, reward & recognition and helping businesses ‘tick’.
